articles.summary: Fifth annual Direction of Technology Report finds 66% of IT partners accelerating AI investment, but only 21% generating meaningful revenue from it TD SYNNEX (NYSE: SNX) today released its fifth annual Direction of Technology (DoT) Report , revealing a significant gap between technology investment and realized value in the technology channel. The report found that while 66% of partners are accelerating investment in AI solutions and services, only 21% derive a meaningful share of revenue from those investments – a 45-point investment-to-revenue gap, the largest among the technologies studied. Based on insights from more than 1,500 channel partners (SMB technology resellers) across 45 countries, the report highlights the growing challenge of turning investments into measurable business outcomes.
